name: io.github.evidai/xstocks
description: Buy tokenized US stocks (xStocks) on Solana via Jupiter DEX in USDC. Daily cap. Dry-run default.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Base58 Solana wallet private key (Phantom export). Leave unset for dry-run mode.

environmentVariables.name: XSTOCKS_ALLOW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'yes-i-understand' to enable real swaps. Dry-run by default.
